scoring_justification: Full recompute T1 not feasible because verifier cannot re-run full training and cross-validation to recompute R² from raw predictions; it would need the original dataset and trained model, making T0 the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden thresholds for R² scores derived from paper Table II values minus tolerance.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II: WaveTENet 10-fold CV R² values: S=0.977, σ=0.984, PF=0.981, κ=0.972, zT=0.963.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Full credit threshold = paper R² - 0.015; partial threshold = paper R² - 0.035. Values embedded in grading_spec steps.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds are directly derived from the paper's reported main experimental results, not invented.

schema.description: Five keys, each mapping to a floating-point R² value computed over the 10-fold cross-validation.

outputs.description: The coefficient of determination (R²) for each of the five thermoelectric properties evaluated via 10-fold cross-validation on the doped ESTM dataset.

output_contract.notes: The agent must report R² values for all five properties. The model training step must reproduce WaveTENet as described; the process evidence files (features_and_targets.npy, cv_predictions.npz) are required to ensure the pipeline was executed even though only the final JSON is scored.

steps.description: R² for Seebeck coefficient S. Paper reported 0.977; full credit if >=0.962, partial if >=0.942.
R² for electrical conductivity σ. Paper reported 0.984; full credit if >=0.969, partial if >=0.949.
R² for power factor PF. Paper reported 0.981; full credit if >=0.966, partial if >=0.946.
R² for thermal conductivity κ. Paper reported 0.972; full credit if >=0.957, partial if >=0.937.
R² for figure of merit zT. Paper reported 0.963; full credit if >=0.948, partial if >=0.928.
